distribution.summary: 安徽；重庆；福建；湖北；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) support Anhui, Fujian, Taiwan and Yunnan. Smith et al. (2020) confirms Anhui, Fujian, Yunnan and Taiwan and adds Chongqing and Hubei. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan and reports China only at broad CE/SE/SW resolution; no provinces are inferred from those regional abbreviations.

host_note: Baseline host set retained; Smith et al. (2020) adds Metasequoia glyptostroboides. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as polyphagous on both gymnosperms and angiosperms, but this broad statement is retained as context and does not add host taxa. Baseline source spelling 'Cunninghania' remains preserved in Source Records; synthesis uses Cunninghamia lanceolata.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Euwallacea validus (Eichhoff, 1876).

taxonomic_history.name: Euwallacea validus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Xyleborus validus; 黄复生等 (2015) and Smith et al. (2020) use Euwallacea validus. Beaver & Liu (2010) also treats the species as Euwallacea validus and independently supports Taiwan occurrence. Canonical authorship follows integrated taxonomic backbone: (Eichhoff, 1876), VSN_2745.
